handoff.authority: GitHub records for each repository; this index records placement, not permission to start jobs
handoff.routing: A/B routing hints are computed from independent GitHub observation snapshots. Before every next batch, read routing.json and verify exact Actions/workflow eligibility. Never auto-dispatch; never transfer an unadmitted lane; do not infer slowdown from one count.
handoff.oscillation: Record source and target revision, lane, job URL, result, provenance and explicit acceptance before transferring state
handoff.b_privacy: The second repository is currently public and its Actions API is readable. If visibility changes, missing source access must be reported as unknown, never zero.
handoff.recovery: Open the shared meta dashboard first. Read both repos' handoff files and GitHub Actions journals. Browser displays public job state; ChatGPT may use the linked accounts to handle separate code/actions.

observation_scope: Public GitHub Actions workflow-run counts sampled periodically; no inferred total job slots, private data or automatic dispatch.

routing_policy.cadence: On every new lane/batch admission and every ChatGPT window reground, check the newest shared routing advice; verify actual GitHub Actions in both accounts before starting next work.
routing_policy.switch: A candidate switch is allowed only for a separately verified and admitted workflow on the receiving node, without moving existing queued jobs.
routing_policy.autonomy: GitHub records signals even when no browser is open; ChatGPT windows do not run in the background or communicate directly.
